d: Short, choppy chestnut brown hair with long bangs and a side-swept fringe is paired with sharp, narrow cyan eyes behind thin-rimmed glasses. The face appears that of a mature adolescent with a slender, athletic build. The outfit consists of a black military-style peaked cap, a black long-coat with cyan accents over a charcoal grey ribbed top and matching grey leggings, and heavy black armored boots. Signature details include a black crossbody utility pouch and a large, ornate futuristic spear with a white and black blade and gold accents.
